g.title: J_VHF_A
g.text: RF board J3 at (-34.5, -19.0), 2 m balun output A (after the LPF and the sense line)

g.title: W10_M_A
g.text: 1.37 mm micro-coax, Molex 73414-0351 R/A MMCX plug both ends

50 Ohm, silver-plated copper inner (no copper-clad steel, ANT-8), FEP/PFA jacket; 0.44 dB port to antenna at 146 MHz worst (cable, plugs, mismatch); 1 W; -X gap band y -20 ... -24; matched to W10_M_B within 2 mm

g.title: J_GNSS_RF
g.text: GNSS receiver RF port (MMCX assumed; SkyFox interface document)
receiver on the deck at (+5, -20); active antenna bias from the receiver

g.title: W10E
g.text: 1.13 mm micro-coax Multicomp Pro MINI-1.13, Molex 73415-2261 R/A MMCX plug both ends
silver-plated copper, FEP; carries the active-antenna bias; about 0.5 dB at 1575 MHz (allocation)
